_schema.description: Reference chart data for uw.metrics.delta_e (CIEDE2000). This file is a SCHEMA PLACEHOLDER — the values below are not measured data and must be replaced before any ΔE number from it is meaningful. data/testset/chart/ is still empty.
_schema.chart: Optional. Free-text identity of the physical chart, for provenance only. Not interpreted by the code.
_schema.reference_illuminant: REQUIRED. The illuminant the reference L/a/b values are relative to: 'D65' or 'D50'. Never assumed. The pipeline works in D65 (sRGB/Rec.709 primaries); D50 references — which is what the published X-Rite ColorChecker tables use — are Bradford-adapted to D65 before comparison, so ΔE measures the pipeline's error and not a white-point mismatch. Mislabelling D50 data as D65 costs roughly 1.0 ΔE of pure bookkeeping error.
_schema.patches: REQUIRED. Map of patch name -> {L, a, b, region}.
_schema.patches.<name>.L: REQUIRED. CIELAB L*, relative to reference_illuminant.
_schema.patches.<name>.region: REQUIRED. Where this patch appears in the frame, as NORMALIZED fractions of frame width/height in [0, 1], origin top-left: {x, y, w, h}. Normalized rather than absolute pixels so one entry stays valid across a 4K master and a downscaled proxy of the same shot. Inset the region from the patch's edges to avoid borders, bevels, and specular highlights. Pixel coordinates pasted here are rejected, not silently misread.
_schema.note_on_lifetimes: L/a/b are a property of the physical chart and are the same in every shot; region is a property of one specific shot and changes whenever the chart is re-filmed. When more than one chart shot exists, expect this to split into a per-chart reference table plus per-shot regions merged before the call — delta_e takes the merged dict.

chart: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the real chart identity
